(2) A second woman with long dark hair, wearing a thin-strapped blue and white striped mini-dress, walks towards the camera. She executes a wide-legged squat to pick up the water bottle. Her movements are quick and deliberate. The background mirrors reflect her form and the hallway's warm, bright indoor lighting. (3) A third woman in a white long-sleeved crop top and a dark denim mini-skirt approaches. She drops into a deep, frontal squat with her knees spread to grab the bottle. The setting remains the same mirrored hallway with polished floors and wooden dividers. (4) A fourth woman wearing a long, form-fitting grey dress walks down the corridor. She kneels down on both knees with an upright torso to reach for the bottle. The camera maintains a static eye-level full shot. (5) A fifth woman in a peach-colored cutout mini-dress walks forward. She squats low and picks up two water bottles simultaneously, holding one in each hand before standing up. (6) A sixth woman with blonde hair, wearing a beige cutout dress, leans against the mirrored wall. As she attempts to squat and grab the bottle, her feet slip on the tiles, causing her to fall backward onto the floor. She laughs as she lands, ending the sequence.
